title: 第19章 算不出来查生死簿吧第20章 阳寿尽勾魂使者现
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: 看到孙悟空，玉皇大帝依然是一脸的嫌弃。
“那个李天王可能遇到了麻烦，他被那个强盗抓走了。”
孙悟空的话，如同一颗小石子落入了池塘中，顿时激起了千层浪。
托塔李天王怎么可能会败？
难道是因为禁魔之地的原因。
在场的众神面面相觑。
“大圣，这是凌霄宝殿，可不能乱说……”
太白金星拎着孙悟空的手腕说道。
“长庚，你又不相信我…”
“那我也没办法…”
孙悟空直接干脆的一屁股坐在了地上。
此时在场的众神也看得出来，孙悟空并不像是说谎的样子。
孙悟空有求于玉皇大帝。
没有必要说谎。
“那贼人是何许人也？”
玉皇大帝打破了尴尬的沉静。
从一开始他们就没有重视对方，现在才想起调查对方的身份。
太白金星随即掐指一算。
可是他怎么算对方都是个普通人。
难道他算错了？
有些好奇的神仙同样在掐指推算。
可是，结果都是一样的。
玉皇大帝在问出的那一刻，心中也在暗自推算。
他的实力是在场众人最强的。
只是他算的结果和众神一样。
楚云一个普通凡间强盗而已，其余天机暗淡，就算不出来了。
“陛下，可宣阎罗王，生死簿一查便知。”
“准奏”
虽然感觉生死不可能查不到什么。
思考良久，玉皇大帝还是点头。
“宣阎罗王，携生死簿上殿。”
仅仅片刻钟。
阎罗王便火急火燎的来到凌霄宝殿上。
“陛下，臣已经查到了那贼人的底细。”
众神都好奇的看向了阎罗王。
连孙悟空也竖起了耳朵。
“快快念与众神听！”
楚云，西域楼兰国人士。
现年28岁，孤儿，早年跟随西域古拳法大师马大师修行。
如今在云望山，占山为王，落草为寇。
打劫樵夫次。
content_en:
Seeing Sun Wukong, the Jade Emperor still looked disgusted.
"That King Li Tian may have been in trouble. He was captured by the robber."
Sun Wukong's words were like a pebble falling into a pond, causing a thousand waves.
How could King Tota Li be defeated?
Could it be because of the Forbidden Demon Land?
The gods present looked at each other.
"Great Sage, this is the Lingxiao Palace, don't talk nonsense..."
Taibai Jinxing held Sun Wukong's wrist and said.
"Chang Geng, you don't believe me..."
"Then there's nothing I can do..."
Sun Wukong simply sat down on the ground.
At this time, the gods present could also see that Sun Wukong did not look like he was lying.
Sun Wukong seeks help from the Jade Emperor.
There is no need to lie.
"Who is the thief?"
The Jade Emperor broke the awkward silence.
They didn't pay attention to each other from the beginning, and only now did they think of investigating each other's identity.
Taibai Jinxing immediately counted with his fingers.
But no matter how he calculated, the other party was an ordinary person.
Did he make a miscalculation?
Some curious gods are also counting on their fingers.
However, the results are the same.
At the moment when the Jade Emperor asked the question, he was also secretly calculating in his heart.
His strength is the strongest among everyone present.
It's just that his calculations are the same as those of the gods.
Chu Yun is just an ordinary mortal robber, and the rest of the secrets are dim and can't be figured out.
"Your Majesty, please declare to King Yama. You can find out by checking the book of life and death."
"Accurate performance"
Although it feels like it’s impossible for Life and Death not to find anything.
After thinking for a long time, the Jade Emperor nodded.
"King Xuan Yama, bring the book of life and death to the palace."
Just a moment.
King Yama came to the Lingxiao Palace in a hurry.
"Your Majesty, I have found out the details of the thief."
All the gods looked at King Yama curiously.
Even Sun Wukong pricked up his ears.
"Recite quickly and listen to the gods!"
"Yes!"
Chu Yun was from the Loulan Kingdom in the Western Regions.
Now 28 years old, he is an orphan. In his early years, he practiced with Master Ma, the ancient boxing master of the Western Regions.
Now in Yunwang Mountain, occupying the mountain is the king, and falling grass is the bandit.
Robbery the woodcutter.
title_en: Chapter 19: You can’t count and check the book of life and death. Chapter 20: Yang Shoujin’s seducer appears.
